description: Add a question or task to an interview section (create the section first with add_interview_section). Tasks are concrete jobs to attempt in the product ("Find the annual plan price and compare it with monthly"); questions probe comprehension and sentiment. Set expected_evidence on tasks so the report can judge success.

expected_evidence.description: What success looks like, so the report can judge the outcome, e.g. "States the annual price and how it compares with paying monthly". Recommended for tasks; omit for open questions.

prompt_text.description: What the interviewer asks or instructs, e.g. "Find the annual plan price and compare it with monthly".

section_id.description: Interview section UUID, from add_interview_section or the sections in get_interview.

sort_order.description: Zero-based position within the section (non-negative integer). Omit to append after the last item.

type.description: "task" for a job the participant attempts in the product, "question" for something they answer in their own words.

name: add_interview_item
title: Add interview item
